## Invoice Desk API
Webhooks for the web UI, behind Header Auth (X-Api-Key). Each endpoint ends in a Respond node that sends `{ status, body }`.

nodes.name: GET /invoices
nodes.notes: Header Auth: X-Api-Key must match INVOICE_API_KEY. The web UI's proxy adds it.

nodes.name: GET /review
nodes.notes: Header Auth: X-Api-Key must match INVOICE_API_KEY. The web UI's proxy adds it.

nodes.name: POST /review/approve
nodes.notes: Header Auth: X-Api-Key must match INVOICE_API_KEY. The web UI's proxy adds it.

return { json: $('Prepare approval').item.json.review_update };

nodes.name: POST /review/reject
nodes.notes: Header Auth: X-Api-Key must match INVOICE_API_KEY. The web UI's proxy adds it.
